name: crawl_url
description: Extract and summarize content from a specific webpage as markdown. Use for 'summarize this URL', 'extract the text from this page', 'scrape this article', or 'read the content at this link'. For JavaScript-heavy or incomplete fetches, use stealth mode. For structured facts, prices, or entities, use extraction_type regex or css. Cosine extraction requires optional server model dependencies. Default wait is normal (all resources loaded); use fast for DOM-ready only and avoid full/network-idle on live data sites. This tool reads one page; it does not click, log in, or follow a browsing trail. For that, use browser_use or browser_use_cloud. For a picture of the page, use screenshot_url.

url.description: Single public HTTP(S) URL to crawl

urls.description: Between 1 and 10 public HTTP(S) URLs (alternative to single url)

stealth.description: Enable stealth mode to bypass bot detection. Use for protected sites like RT, IMDB, news sites.

wait_for.description: CSS selector to wait for before extracting content (e.g., '.main-content', '#article')

wait_for_js.description: DEPRECATED - use wait_strategy instead. Kept for backwards compatibility.

wait_strategy.description: How long to wait for page load: 'fast' (DOM only), 'normal' (all resources, DEFAULT), 'full' (network idle - AVOID for live data sites like financial/news)

page_timeout.description: Page load timeout in milliseconds (default 30000, max 60000)

delay_before_return_html.description: Seconds to wait after page load for JS to render (default 3.0, max 10.0)

exclude_tags.description: HTML tags to exclude from output (default: nav, footer, aside, script, style)

extraction_type.description: Extraction strategy: 'cosine' (semantic filtering; requires optional server model dependencies), 'regex' (built-in pattern families), 'css' (CSS selector schema). Omit for raw markdown.

semantic_filter.description: For extraction_type=cosine: topic/keyword to filter content by relevance (e.g., 'gold price forecast')

top_k.description: For extraction_type=cosine: number of top results to return (default 5)

regex_patterns.description: For extraction_type=regex: select built-in families email, phone, url, currency, date, percentage. Defaults to all six; phone includes international/US formats and date includes ISO/US formats. Arbitrary regex is not accepted here.

css_schema.description: For extraction_type=css: JsonCssExtractionStrategy schema {baseSelector: 'article', fields: [{name, selector, type}]}

availability.setup_hint: Set CRAWL4AI_URL and CRAWL4AI_API_KEY (native Bearer token) in the active mode env.
